# Subway Seat for highlight.js

A highlight.js stylesheet per flavor, using the same syntax colors as the editor themes.

[highlight.js](https://highlightjs.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/highlightjs/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.css`](subway-seat.css) | `your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat.css` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.css`](subway-seat-tunnel.css) | `your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat-tunnel.css` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.css`](subway-seat-enamel.css) | `your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat-enamel.css` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in your page's <head>, in place of a stock highlight.js theme:

```xml
<link rel="stylesheet" href="subway-seat.css">
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in your page's <head>, in place of a stock highlight.js theme:

```xml
<link rel="stylesheet" href="subway-seat-tunnel.css">
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in your page's <head>, in place of a stock highlight.js theme:

```xml
<link rel="stylesheet" href="subway-seat-enamel.css">
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat.css`.
- Delete `your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat-tunnel.css`.
- Delete `your site's assets, e.g. css/subway-seat-enamel.css`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
